title: Capstone Seminar in Statistics
instructor: Kerby Shedden (GSIs: Jaylin Lowe, Abhiti Mishra)

gradingBreakdown.component: Writing memos (unweighted average, ~8 assignments, no exams)

weeklyTopics: ~8 case studies, each covering roughly 3 lectures of background/statistical issues followed by a 10-day writing assignment
Case study domains include human health, social/behavioral science, natural science, and industry/commerce
Statistical methods used are drawn from the shared case-studies repo: GLMs, GEE, mixed/multilevel regression, survival analysis, dimension reduction, time series
Technical/scientific writing: framing a research question, justifying methods, interpreting findings in a 2-3 page memo
workloadNotes: Satisfies the LSA Upper Level Writing Requirement (ULWR) for Statistics/Data Science majors. ~8 individual case-study writing memos (2-3 pages) graded on a 4-part rubric (focus, methods/approach, writing/organization, findings/interpretation, 25 points each); course grade is an unweighted average; no exams or quizzes; code is not submitted or graded.
